description_hint: 소리 내어 읽어줄 아주 짧은 한 문장. 공백 포함 12자 안팎, 행동 하나만. '~고', '~해서', '~한 뒤', 쉼표로 행동을 잇지 않는다 (나쁜 예: '이불을 덮고 누워요', 좋은 예: '침대에 누워요'). title을 되풀이하지 않고 쉬운 말로 (예: '학교 갈 옷을 입어요')

imagePromptEn.description: One English sentence (under 25 words) telling the illustrator what to draw. Start with 'The character'. Show one visible pose and the 1-2 objects held or used, placed where they are (e.g. 'The character stands at a sink and rubs a bar of soap between both hands.'). Always include one prop that identifies the activity (stethoscope for a check-up, pill and cup for medicine, wallet and coins for paying). Turn invisible actions (rest, wait, meet, arrive) into a visible pose (sits on a bench with hands on knees). Draw only the character: never other people or animals (grandmother, friend, doctor are shown by objects only). No background places, weather, traffic. Describe packaged goods and appliances (milk, medicine, snacks, registers) as plain and unmarked, with nothing printed on them. Never use words that cause text in the picture: exit, sign, label, menu, clock, title, card, ticket, number.
